errors.text: The proposed CALPHAD-plus-lattice-distortion surrogate does not reconstruct the target DFT/MTP/FEP free-energy methodology.

The central claim that lattice distortion and configurational entropy stabilize the solid against melting and can predict fusion properties without modeling the liquid free energy is not established by the cited evidence.
None of the cited sources validates a correlation between lattice-distortion metrics and melting temperature, entropy of fusion, or heat capacity.
The hypothesis omits essential liquid-phase sampling and the equality of solid and liquid Gibbs free energies needed for a thermodynamically grounded melting prediction.
Heat capacity, explicitly requested in the problem, is neither modeled nor included in the validation experiment.
The claimed accuracy and speed improvements are unsupported numerical assertions.
